root_cause: Generated first-party CTA producer returned after sendBeacon acceptance without checking durable queue acknowledgement; this is a reliability gap, not proven sole cause of missing conversions.
fix: Critical CTA/form intent uses fetch keepalive and checks exact event_id and durable queue ACK; one same-body retry if consent remains granted; no permanent 4xx/429 retry.
prevention_rule: Run generated-browser behavioral tests; durable queue ACK is not DataHub persistence or lead/order. Keep one producer and original protected writer.
terminal_rule: Exact candidate Required/BRAIN/CodeQL, protected merge, Netlify production matching SHA, public browser event and private first-party provider persistence readback. This public record is generic source-level software documentation, not a private Brain export.
